rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: the on-disk schema of the operator allow-overlay - two positive lists (Allow exact tool names, AllowPrefix tool-name prefixes) that UNION into the guard floor's allow-list at launch.
rows.distinction: A WIDEN-only positive overlay (a strict subset of the policy manifest: no deny, no arg-rules) - NOT guardDenyOverlay (the tighten-only deny list) and NOT the guard floor policy itself, which it only extends.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: a single named source of allow entries - a {Name, Path} pair naming one layer ('env', 'user', or 'repo') in the ordered stack of overlay files that are read and unioned.
rows.distinction: ONE named source in the read stack - NOT guardAllowOverlay (the merged allow schema after all layers union) and NOT guardAllowOverlayLayerPaths (the flattened list of just the paths).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: returns the effective ORDERED layers to read - an env override is the sole layer when set, otherwise the per-user layer unioned before the repo-local layer.
rows.distinction: The READ resolver (returns []guardAllowOverlayLayer, all layers) - NOT guardAllowOverlayPath (singular, the default WRITE target: env or repo-local) and NOT guardAllowOverlayLayerPaths (the same layers flattened to plain path strings).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: flattens guardAllowOverlayPaths to just the ordered list of filesystem path strings, dropping the layer names.
rows.distinction: A []string of PATHS ONLY - NOT guardAllowOverlayPaths (the richer []{Name,Path} layer list it flattens) and NOT loadGuardAllowOverlayLayers (which reads those paths and merges their contents).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: reads every allow-overlay layer and UNIONS their Allow / AllowPrefix lists into one normalized merged guardAllowOverlay, returning both the merge and the layers it read.
rows.distinction: The multi-layer MERGE (reads all layers, unions) - NOT loadGuardAllowOverlay (reads and validates ONE file) and NOT guardAllowOverlayPaths (which only enumerates the layers, reading nothing).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: canonicalizes a string list by trimming whitespace, dropping empties and duplicates, and sorting - so the merged overlay and its on-disk file stay a clean, order-independent diff.
rows.distinction: The pure list-CANONICALIZER (trim/dedupe/sort) - NOT guardAllowSubtract (which removes a deny set from a list) and NOT saveGuardAllowOverlay (which normalizes then writes to disk).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: normalizes an overlay and writes it as pretty, newline-terminated JSON to a path (creating the parent dir), delegating the durable write to writeGuardAllowOverlayAtomic.
rows.distinction: The high-level SAVE (normalize + serialize + place) - NOT writeGuardAllowOverlayAtomic (the low-level temp-file+rename durability primitive it calls) and NOT loadGuardAllowOverlay (the read half of the round-trip).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: the durability primitive - writes the overlay body to a sibling temp file, chmods, fsyncs, then renames it into place so a crash never leaves a half-written overlay.
rows.distinction: The low-level ATOMIC bytes writer (temp+sync+rename) - NOT saveGuardAllowOverlay (its caller, which supplies the normalized JSON body) and NOT guardAllowNormalize (which shapes that body's contents).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go: renders the overlay's path and its Allow / AllowPrefix entries to an io.Writer for the operator to inspect what the allow surface currently widens.
rows.distinction: A read-only human RENDERER of the allow overlay - NOT saveGuardAllowOverlay (which mutates the file) and NOT printGuardDenyOverlay (the deny-side renderer).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_deny.go: the on-disk schema of the operator deny-overlay - a single Deny list of tool names that are removed from the guard floor's allow-list, and which WINS over the allow overlay.
rows.distinction: A TIGHTEN-only negative overlay (Deny only) that beats allow - NOT guardAllowOverlay (the widen-only positive overlay) and NOT the danger arg-rules baked into the floor, which no overlay can touch.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_deny.go: resolves the deny-overlay file path - the FAK_GUARD_DENY_OVERLAY env override when set, otherwise repo-local .fak/guard/deny.json.
rows.distinction: The DENY overlay's single path resolver - NOT guardAllowOverlayPath (the allow side) and NOT guardAllowOverlayPaths (the multi-layer allow read stack; the deny side has no layering).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_deny.go: reads and validates the deny-overlay file - a missing file yields an empty overlay (fail-open), a malformed or wrong-version file fails loud.
rows.distinction: The deny-overlay READER/validator - NOT guardApplyDenyOverlay (which applies the loaded deny list to a live policy runtime) and NOT loadGuardAllowOverlay (the allow-side reader).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_deny.go: applies a loaded deny overlay onto a live policy.Runtime at startup - subtracting each denied tool from the effective allow-list and returning how many were removed.
rows.distinction: The runtime MUTATOR (removes tools from a live policy runtime) - NOT loadGuardDenyOverlay (which only reads the file) and NOT loadGuardAllowOverlayLayers (which unions the positive allow layers before this subtracts).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow.go guardAllowOverlayEnv: env var that points the allow overlay at a non-default file (e.g. a host-wide overlay shared across repos); when unset the overlay is repo-local (.fak/guard/allow.json).
rows.distinction: The ALLOW overlay's path knob - NOT FAK_GUARD_DENY_OVERLAY (the deny side) and NOT the overlay schema guardAllowOverlay it merely locates; setting it makes the env layer the SOLE read layer.
